caption: The drawing depicts a large stoneware jug with a cylindrical body that tapers into a short neck with a rimmed mouth. The jug is colored in shades of light brown and gray, giving it an earthenware appearance. On the upper part of the jug, there is a blue floral design featuring curved lines, leaves, and stylized petals, applied in a decorative pattern across the front. Near the neck, there is some small black text, along with the number "3" below it. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset illustration showing a side perspective of the jug, which includes a handle attached from the neck to the shoulder of the jug and repeats a portion of the blue floral design. The main composition is framed by a faint rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "N. Aimantea," appears at the bottom right of the main rectangle. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color.
title: Jug
